itens.titulo: 3M raises 2026 earnings guidance after quarterly profit growth
itens.descricao: 3M raises 2026 earnings guidance after quarterly profit growth Yahoo Finance
trechos: 3M Co (NYSE:MMM) raised its full-year 2026 earnings guidance after third-quarter adjusted earnings per share increased 12% to $2.50.
The company now expects adjusted earnings per share of $9.10 to $9.15 for 2026, incorporating its performance so far this year and an updated approach to reporting certain costs.
Third-quarter adjusted sales rose 4.2% year on year to $6.6 billion, including organic growth of 3.3%, which excludes the effects of acquisitions, disposals and other specified factors.
Reported sales increased 1% to $6.6 billion, while organic sales grew 0.2%, reflecting a difference between the reported and adjusted measures.
Adjusted operating margin, which measures the proportion of revenue remaining after operating costs, increased 110 basis points to 26.2% on the company's updated reporting basis.
Reported earnings per share rose 70% to $2.63, while the reported operating margin increased 150 basis points to 23.7% from 22.2% a year earlier.

3M generated $500 million in operating cash flow during the quarter and reported adjusted free cash flow of $1.2 billion, while returning $600 million to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.
The revised full-year outlook also includes adjusted total sales growth of more than 4.5%, with adjusted organic sales growth expected to exceed 3.5%.

itens.titulo: What could a Tesla-SpaceX merger earn? Cathie Wood's Ark Invest has a $2.7 trillion answer.
itens.descricao: What could a Tesla-SpaceX merger earn? Cathie Wood's Ark Invest has a $2.7 trillion answer. Yahoo Finance
trechos: The Elon Musk bull's firm estimated that SpaceX and Tesla could generate $3.8 trillion in sales and $2.7 trillion in operating profits by 2031, with SpaceX contributing roughly 62% and 69%, respectively.
To get a sense of how bullish a call this is, Yahoo Finance data shows that Wall Street analysts expect SpaceX to post $43 billion in sales this year, while Tesla clocks in at $107 billion.
"While our model assesses Tesla as a standalone business, a SpaceX-Tesla merger could take place within the next five years," the Ark Invest team said.

"Tesla's highly cash-generative robotaxi network could help fund SpaceX's ambitious plans for orbital data centers, and at the same time SpaceX's compute-intensive frontier AI models could serve as the planning layer for Optimus deployments.

Working together on the Terafab project, both companies could alleviate chip constraints." It has been an eventful few weeks for CEO Elon Musk as chatter heats up about a merger between SpaceX and Tesla.
Musk said on Monday he would give one share of SpaceX stock to every kid in America in 2027.

"We believe this is a small example of the synergies between Tesla and SpaceX and we believe there is an 80% chance that Tesla and SpaceX merge by the end of 2027 for a number of strategic AI/data driven reasons," Yorkville Ives partner Dan Ives said.

itens.titulo: These 2 Billionaires Like Nvidia (NVDA). Should You Buy the Dip Ahead of Earnings?
itens.descricao: These 2 Billionaires Like Nvidia (NVDA). Should You Buy the Dip Ahead of Earnings? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Two famous billionaires in the hedge fund industry held it in the second quarter, and it ranks first in our list of 7 AI stocks billionaires Ken Fisher and Paul Tudor Jones were buying.
What Pulled Nvidia Lower Nvidia fell more than 3% on October 14 as worries about AI debt hit chip stocks, and it slid again the next day.
CoreWeave, a cloud company that rents out Nvidia chips and carries heavy debt, lost about 25% last week as its bonds sold off.
Hotter inflation data pushed Treasury yields above 5%, which makes it more expensive to finance data centers.
Chip stocks bounced on Monday after nine straight losing days, and Nvidia now trades around $218 a share, below the record high it reached in early October.
Management expects revenue to grow about 70% in fiscal 2028, and Nvidia more than doubled its purchase commitments for memory and manufacturing capacity in one quarter to deliver that growth.
Microsoft's Azure cloud grew 43% in its latest quarter, and customers want more capacity than the company can supply, which we covered in our look at whether Microsoft's AI spending is paying off.

L1 Capital raised its Nvidia stake in the second quarter and now counts it among its five largest holdings, according to its investor letter, which we covered in Nvidia Strengthens with Improving AI Capabilities and Stronger Capital Expenditure.

itens.titulo: 3M Jumps 6% on Expanded Amazon Data Center Deal and Earnings Beat; Coherent Edges Higher, Corning Stays Flat
itens.descricao: 3M Jumps 6% on Expanded Amazon Data Center Deal and Earnings Beat; Coherent Edges Higher, Corning Stays Flat Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - 3M surged 6% after beating Q3 EPS at $2.50 versus the $2.39 consensus and announcing an expanded Amazon data center partnership.
- Amazon's 7-year warrant to acquire roughly 3 million 3M shares vests primarily once cumulative data center purchases reach $6 billion.
(Sponsor) 3M (NYSE:MMM) stock jumped 6% to $171.91 as investors weighed an expanded Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) data center relationship alongside better-than-expected quarterly earnings.
The advance outpaced Coherent (NYSE:COHR) stock, which gained 1.33% to $235.11, while Corning (NYSE:GLW) stock was essentially flat, slipping 0.21% to $132.46.
Those moves put 3M stock well ahead of the two peers today.
Amazon Agreement Expands the Opportunity 3M expanded its commercial relationship with Amazon to deploy and scale optical connectivity and other data center products.
The agreement gives 3M a potential growth opportunity as Amazon invests in infrastructure supporting cloud computing and AI workloads.
As part of the arrangement, 3M issued an Amazon subsidiary a seven-year warrant to purchase up to approximately 3.16 million 3M shares at $164.89 each.
